description.p: Pomander keeps your iCloud calendar, reminders, notes, contacts and Drive on your own machine. Everything opens straight away and works without a connection, and what you change here reaches your other devices.

You sign in once with your Apple ID and stay signed in. Nothing is stored on anybody else's server: there is no Pomander account and no Pomander service, and your credentials never leave this computer.

Pomander is an independent project. It is not made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Apple, and it reaches iCloud through interfaces Apple has not published, which means they can change without warning. Services that Apple encrypts end to end — Health, Messages, Keychain and others — cannot be read by any client and are shown as unavailable rather than quietly left out.
Calendar, Reminders, Notes, Contacts and iCloud Drive, all readable and writable, kept in step with your other devices.
